caption: The drawing consists of a small, rectangular swatch of woven fabric positioned slightly above and to the right of the center of an otherwise plain, light beige or off-white background. The fabric swatch displays a combination of muted colors, including gray-blue, rust red, brown, and beige in a subtle, interwoven pattern. The top edge of the fabric appears unfinished, with several loose threads of light blue and beige extending outward, curling and trailing off to the upper right. The right edge of the fabric also has some loose threads hanging freely. The weave of the fabric is clearly depicted, showing individual threads and their intersections. Below the fabric and slightly centered, there is a faint handwritten inscription that reads "Magnus S. Fossum."
title: Linen and Cotton Homespun
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
